prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [finish, redesign] Interactive compact layout for home welcome step: Redesign the home_intro screen using a compact layout with an interactive control preview component.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "body": "Your pet is now active on your desktop screen! Click to pet, drag to move, or right-click for quick controls.", "components": [{"type": "preview", "asset": "asset:pet_controls_preview", "style": "rounded"}]}}
1: [home, wait_info] Desktop setup guidance on waiting screen: Add visible progress status and desktop visibility instructions to the pet generation waiting screen.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_progress": true, "show_time_estimate": true, "hint": "Your pet will automatically pop up on your desktop when ready. Keep this window open during setup.", "notify_when_ready": true}}
2: [sign_in, redesign] List layout sign-in screen redesign: Redesign the sign-in screen into a structured list layout clearly distinguishing existing account login from guest registration.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "list", "headline": "Sign in to save your desktop pet", "body": "Connect your account to sync your pet settings and prevent pet resets on reinstall.", "hint": "Returning user? Sign in with your previous login method to restore your active pets."}}
3: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-adoption custom photo verification screen: Insert a dedicated photo check screen before upload to verify lighting and pet photo resolution.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "new_photo_check", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"hint": "Use a clear, front-facing pet photo with good lighting for best custom generation."}}
4: [adoption, redesign] Two-column layout for pick friend screen: Rebuild the pick_friend screen with a two-column layout comparing preset pets next to custom photo creation options.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Select Your Desktop Friend", "body": "Choose a classic preset buddy or generate a custom companion from your photos."}}
5: [choose_path, new_flow] Story intro path selection flow: Add an interactive story introduction screen before choose_path to guide user expectations before path selection.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "new_path_intro", "choose_path", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "sign_in", "home_intro"], "choose_path": {"headline": "Which pet experience do you want?", "body": "Pick a quick ready-made desktop pet or upload photos to craft your custom companion."}}
6: [adoption, incentive] Adoption certificate memory guarantee callout: Add a prominent permanent memory badge component to the adoption certificate screen.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"hint": "Your adoption certificate registers your pet's permanent ID to your device.", "components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Permanent Pet ID Registered", "style": "highlight"}]}}
7: [finish, hint] Desktop tray and hotkey control hint: Display explicit hotkey and system tray control hints on the home_intro screen.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Control your pet anytime by right-clicking it on your desktop or clicking its system tray icon."}}
8: [choose_path, copy] Clear path comparison copy on story screen: Update story screen headline and body text to set distinct expectations between instant pet selection and photo generation.
   config: {"story": {"headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets", "body": "Choose a pre-made friend to launch instantly, or create a personalized pet from your photos.", "button_label": "Start Pet Setup"}}
9: [home, notification] Ready notification trigger on waiting step: Enable desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app during pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "hint": "Feel free to minimize this app. We will notify you on your desktop as soon as your pet is ready!"}}

verdicts.reason: Redesign of home_intro screen within onboarding complies with all rules.
Adding progress and setup guidance to the waiting screen retains its required job and complies with all rules.
Redesigning the sign-in screen into a list layout retains its job and keeps all onboarding steps intact.
Adding a new verification step to the onboarding flow is allowed under Rule 4.
Two-column layout redesign for picking a friend retains the screen's core job and keeps pricing intact.
Adding an intro step before path selection is a valid addition within onboarding.
Replacing adoption certificate components with a permanent ID badge removes the required official stamp.
Adding hotkey and tray control hints to home_intro is allowed and preserves all existing functionality.
Updating story screen copy still fulfills the job of introducing the pet without touching pricing or structure.
Enabling desktop notification prompts on the waiting screen preserves the waiting screen's job and complies with fair design rules.
